name: ignitron-2k26-monorepo
description: IGNITRON 2K26 — Code Relay Competition Platform Monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ignitron/backend && npm run build -w @ignitron/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev -w @ignitron/backend" "npm run dev -w @ignitron/frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @ignitron/frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @ignitron/backend
